name: cli-database-build
description: M23 W3.3: one inbound ('set up a postgres database for the app') drives install_packages (apt: postgresql + postgresql-client, scope image) -> write_file of the .copperclaw/services start line -> final text. Pins the databases capability path: the install_packages system row is applied to container_configs.packages_apt by the delivery loop, and the services registration lands on disk.
